checks.definition: CHECK (((type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['info'::character varying, 'success'::character varying, 'warning'::character varying, 'error'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CV'::character varying, 'portfolio'::character varying, 'NDA'::character varying, 'agreement'::character varying, 'certification'::character varying, 'IT_Ethics_Policy'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['new'::character varying, 'reviewing'::character varying, 'matching'::character varying, 'closed'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((category)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Payment Issues'::character varying, 'Technical Support'::character varying, 'Verification'::character varying, 'Guidance'::character varying, 'Contract Question'::character varying, 'Billing Issue'::character varying, 'Talent Performance Concern'::character varying, 'Vetting Question'::character varying, 'Technical Bug'::character varying, 'Account Access'::character varying, 'Payment Issue'::character varying, 'Other'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((priority)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Low'::character varying, 'Medium'::character varying, 'High'::character varying, 'Urgent'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Open'::character varying, 'In Progress'::character varying, 'Resolved'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['todo'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying, 'review'::character varying, 'done'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['talent'::character varying, 'client'::character varying, 'super_admin'::character varying, 'account_manager'::character varying, 'talent_manager'::character varying, 'ops_manager'::character varying, 'finance'::character varying, 'skill_assessor'::character varying])::text[])))
